paragraphs.text: Igort Uriklatz owned many pets and ran afoul of the Leash Laws of the Azorius guild.

Igort Uriklatz was the owner of 22 registered pets, including a Drekavac , an Ursapine , and an ogre . At one point, the ogre broke free of his restraints and rumbled out the door and through the streets, tipping over Orzhov merchant carts and trouncing Selesnyan Criers. It rampaged for a short while until Boros officers easily handled it. They traced the blood and wreckage back to Igort’s home. They secured the secondary crime scene and signaled for a Sky Hussar patrol there. Igortz was arrested for Disturbing Commerce and breaking the Leash Laws , which require all pets to be leashed at all times. After a three-and-a-half-year trial, Igortz received a fine, lost his pet license, and lost all 22 of his pets to the Simic . Igortz then later created a Leashling with an Izzet guild member. Since it was physically made of leashes, Igortz thus ensured that his pet would always follow the Leash Laws.
